initiatives.name: Fintecy
initiatives.tagline: A single entry point for your financial life
initiatives.description: Connect brokers and banks read-only, get FIFO realised P&L across accounts, and plan long-horizon with data you own.
initiatives.proof: Registered company with its own trademark and ICO data-protection registration — built to hold real account data, not just demo it.

initiatives.name: SHIP
initiatives.tagline: A typed knowledge graph for engineering teams
initiatives.description: Goals, decisions, and artefacts as typed nodes instead of prose. Agents read and write the graph over MCP, and every agent write carries provenance and an audit trail.
initiatives.proof: Provenance is the design constraint: each node records which agent or human wrote it, from which source, and what it superseded.

testimonials.quote: Anton is a rare blend of deep fintech expertise and strategic leadership. At Deutsche Bank, he led the expansion of our FX risk platform to Fixed Income, replacing legacy systems with a scalable, high-performance risk solution. His ability to architect complex financial systems while aligning stakeholders made a lasting impact.
